summary: Lets a signed-in adventurer save the line tool's completed draft (two points placed on the land) through the mock API's existing POST /api/expeditions, show it as a normal expedition the moment it saves and again on every later visit, and refuse the save with a visible message when nobody is signed in or the two points are the same place within 1 km — then turns the reagent map on by default by flipping VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP to true in .env (currently false), while the flag can still turn it off. Purely additive within the ReagentMapView/expeditions.ts pattern reagent-map-line-tool and reagent-map-expeditions already established (AbortController/REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS fetch shape, saturdayMetadata entity tagging, draftPoints/draftEntities state) — no new package, base class, or layer boundary. apps/mock-api/server.js already implements POST /api/expeditions's full contract (requireAuth, isValidPoint, geodesicDistanceKm zero-length rejection at MIN_EXPEDITION_DISTANCE_KM=1, per-adventurer ownership via req.userId) and is out of scope. The order also adds a new cross-cutting test-isolation requirement (reagent-map specs must not corrupt each other's view of apps/mock-api/data/expeditions.json under --workers=3 --repeat-each=3) whose concrete mechanism is not yet decided — see architecturalFlags.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Elara, signed in, MUST see her saved expedition drawn again after reopening the reagent map, and the shop MUST hold it with both ends within 1 km of where she placed them (spec AC11, rule R6).
examples: Elara draws Moonwell Spring to Ember Crag, clicks save, reloads /reagent-map: the expedition is drawn, and a direct GET /api/expeditions with her token includes it with both ends within 1 km of the drawn points.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: When no adventurer is signed in and a completed line is on the map, saving it MUST ask the adventurer to sign in and MUST NOT send a POST or store anything (spec AC12, rule R7).
examples: Signed out, clicking save on a completed line shows a sign-in message; no POST /api/expeditions is observed via route interception; a follow-up GET /api/expeditions is unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: When both points of a completed line are less than 1 km apart, saving it MUST show the server's own zero-length message and MUST NOT store anything (spec AC13, rule R7).
examples: Elara places both points on the same spot and saves: the message 'Zero-length line: from and to are the same place' (the 422 body's own text, never a client-recomputed one) is shown, and GET /api/expeditions afterward has no new entry.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: An unsaved line MUST NOT be shown, and nothing MUST be stored, after the adventurer leaves the reagent map and opens it again (spec AC15, rule R8).
examples: Elara places one or two points, never clicks save, navigates away and back to /reagent-map: no draft point or draft line entity remains, and GET /api/expeditions is unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Once this order ships, apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/.env MUST set VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP=true so the nav link and route show by default, and setting the variable to false MUST still hide both.

Every test that saves an expedition MUST restore apps/mock-api/data/expeditions.json afterward, and no test MUST see an expedition another test saved, proven by running the reagent map specs at --workers=3 --repeat-each=3 with reagent-map-expeditions.spec.ts still counting exactly Elara's expeditions. No existing count assertion MUST be loosened to make this pass.

Only a @visual baseline this order changes on purpose MUST be regenerated, in both runner images, via scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh --update-baselines and --ubi9 --update-baselines; every changed PNG MUST be viewed by eye and the delivery record MUST state what changed and why; no tolerance MUST be raised.

Every new or changed function MUST keep cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered by a test proven able to fail, and no file outside scope.paths MUST change except this order's own delivery record under docs/features/reagent-map-save/.

nonFunctionalRequirements.requirement: The save request MUST NOT leave the app's own origin or the mock API's own origin, matching every other client call in ReagentMapView/expeditions.ts.

The client MUST NOT send an owner or adventurer identifier in the save request body; apps/mock-api/server.js derives ownership from req.userId (session token) alone, so one adventurer's expedition can never be attributed to another.
saveExpedition() MUST set an explicit AbortController timeout, matching fetchExpeditions()'s existing REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS budget, rather than waiting on the network indefinitely.

The save control and the sign-in/zero-length message MUST be reachable by keyboard and announced to a screen reader, matching the existing start-line-tool button (aria-label) and reagent-map-error (role="alert") conventions.

architecturalFlags: Unresolved: the cross-file Playwright worker-isolation mechanism required by the claim's new AC (no test sees an expedition another test saved, proven at --workers=3 --repeat-each=3) is not decided. reagent-map-save.spec.ts (new, writes), reagent-map-api.spec.ts (existing, writes, but only test.describe.configure({mode:'serial'}) within its own file), and reagent-map-expeditions.spec.ts (existing, asserts exact entity counts) can run in different workers concurrently against the same shared apps/mock-api/data/expeditions.json, and apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/playwright.config.ts (fullyParallel: true, single shared webServer) is outside this order's scope.paths, so project dependencies or a parallelism change there are not available. Needs an architect decision on an in-scope mechanism (e.g. a cross-file file-lock/mutex fixture used by every expeditions.json-writing spec) that is also reconciled against architecture-guardrails.md #5's ban on custom retry-with-sleep loops before developer/qa-engineer implement it.

Carried forward from performance-engineer's prior (now stale) gate: canSaveLine only guards point count, not an in-flight request, so a double-click on save-line-tool within the 5s timeout window can send two POSTs against the non-idempotent POST /api/expeditions. Required before developer sign-off: an isSaving ref set at the top of saveLine() and cleared in a finally, mirrored onto the save button's :disabled binding alongside the existing !canSaveLine check — a one-line addition to the handler, not a new control. developer: In apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/src/api/expeditions.ts, add export async function saveExpedition(from: GeoPoint, to: GeoPoint): Promise<Expedition>: POST to `${API_BASE}/api/expeditions` with headers { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...getAuthHeaders() }, body JSON.stringify({ from, to }), and the same AbortController/REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=5000ms timeout as fetchExpeditions().

In saveExpedition(), on a non-ok response, parse the JSON body and throw new Error(body.error ?? 'Failed to save expedition.') so the server's own message (e.g. the 422 zero-length text) reaches the caller verbatim; on ok, return the parsed Expedition.

In ReagentMapView.vue, import saveExpedition alongside fetchExpeditions, and useAuthStore from '../stores/authStore'; call const authStore = useAuthStore() (App.vue already calls authStore.hydrate() before this view mounts, so isAuthenticated is ready to read).

Add const canSaveLine = computed(() => draftPoints.value.length === MAX_LINE_POINTS), const saveMessage = ref<string | null>(null), and const isSaving = ref(false) (the double-click guard carried forward from performance-engineer's finding).

Add async function saveLine(): Promise<void>: return early if !canSaveLine.value or isSaving.value; if !authStore.isAuthenticated, set saveMessage to a sign-in prompt and return without calling saveExpedition (AC12 — no network call when signed out); otherwise set isSaving.value = true and call saveExpedition(draftPoints.value[0], draftPoints.value[1]) in a try/catch/finally that clears isSaving.value.

On saveLine()'s success path: clear saveMessage, call clearDraftEntities(), reset draftPoints to [] and toolStarted to false, append the returned expedition to expeditions.value, and call addExpeditionEntities(cesium!, viewer!, ellipsoid!, [returned expedition]) so it is drawn exactly like any other expedition (AC11) — no refetch of the whole list.

On saveLine()'s catch path: set saveMessage to `err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to save expedition.'` and leave the draft line and its entities untouched so the adventurer can retry without redrawing.

Add a save button beside start-line-tool, outside all four @visual-captured regions (header, reagent-site-list, reagent-map-error, #cesiumContainer): data-testid="save-line-tool", aria-label="Save this expedition", v-if="toolStarted", :disabled="!canSaveLine || isSaving", @click="saveLine".

edgeCases.case: Save is attempted with fewer than two draft points.
edgeCases.handling: The save button is hidden until toolStarted and disabled until canSaveLine (draftPoints.length === MAX_LINE_POINTS); saveLine() also returns early on the same guard.

edgeCases.case: No adventurer signed in, completed line on the map.
edgeCases.handling: authStore.isAuthenticated is checked before any network call; a sign-in message is shown and saveExpedition() is never invoked, so no POST reaches the server (AC12).

edgeCases.case: Both points less than 1 km apart.
edgeCases.handling: The POST is sent (the client does not duplicate the server's geodesicDistanceKm logic); the server's 422 response body.error is displayed verbatim, never a client-recomputed message (AC13).

edgeCases.case: Save request times out or the network fails.
edgeCases.handling: saveExpedition()'s 5s AbortController timeout rejects; saveLine()'s catch path shows a generic failure message and leaves the draft line and its entities intact for a retry.

edgeCases.case: Adventurer double-clicks the save control before the first request resolves.
edgeCases.handling: isSaving guards the handler and the button's :disabled binding, so only one POST is sent per completed line (performance-engineer finding, carried into developer tasks).

edgeCases.case: Adventurer leaves the reagent map with an unsaved line and reopens it.
edgeCases.handling: Draft state (draftPoints, draftEntities) lives only in ReagentMapView's own refs/module-scope variables; onBeforeUnmount destroys the viewer and the component unmounts on route change, so nothing persists (AC15).
Draft entities are cleared, the tool is reset to not-started, and the server's returned expedition is appended to expeditions.value and drawn via addExpeditionEntities — no refetch of the full list.

edgeCases.case: Multiple reagent-map spec files run concurrently against the shared apps/mock-api/data/expeditions.json under --workers=3.
edgeCases.handling: Unresolved — see architecturalFlags; must be settled before qa-engineer implements reagent-map-save.spec.ts.

A double-click on save produces exactly one stored expedition.
.env sets VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP=true; the nav link and route show by default; setting the variable to false still hides both.
The four existing @visual baselines are regenerated in both runner images and reviewed by eye; the delivery record states the outcome and why for each; no tolerance raised.
